gaps.lead: You won't get a seat unless you book.
I'd love to be on a beach now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past (subjunctive were): I wish I were. 'was' is informal — only 'were' fits the keyword.

gaps.answer: though his salary is / though it is low…
gaps.lead: His salary is low, but he enjoys his work.
gaps.explanation: …though his salary is low — 'though' links the concession.

gaps.lead: She speaks French fluently; she also speaks Russian.
gaps.sentence: She speaks French fluently and, ___, Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition adds a parallel fact: and, in addition, Russian.

gaps.lead: She prefers reading to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: shouldn't have + participle criticises a past action.
